source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design), broken out by self-reported activity level in the Church (q406). q416's "donate but not a full 10%" response and its own don't know/refused are excluded from each row's denominator, since this chart answers q416's own yes/no framing (pay a full tithe, or not). Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
